title: diasperus nummularioides
intro: Diasperus nummularioides, commonly known as Dipterocarpus nummularioides, is a plant species in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is native to the tropical regions of Asia, specifically in countries such as India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Diasperus nummularioides include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective properties.
